meaning: Accepted reusable CLI scopes on simlox/main. The catalog-v2.json planning snapshot is intentionally frozen and its legacy publication_state fields are not current publication decisions. Each evidence document defines the actual accepted behavior and limits. Unlisted cases and variants are not implied to be published.
